card.name: Nouns ending a body or group phrase
card.fires_on: The head noun that completes a phrase about the body, people or society, such as 'your body', 'respiratory system', 'against children' or 'scientific community'. It appears in general web text, not in drug-label text.

modes.label: Body and health nouns
modes.description: The noun that ends a phrase about the body or a body system.
modes.example: Harmful impacts to your respiratory<< system>>.

modes.label: People and society nouns
modes.description: The noun that ends a phrase about a group of people, a community or humanity.
modes.example: violence against<< children>> remains a global problem.

modes.label: Reflexive or possessive endings
modes.description: The final word after a possessive or object, such as souls, conscience or oneself.

card.plain: It fires on the last noun of a phrase about the body, people or society, just before the phrase ends.
